dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visibility and sharp boundary sharpness; thin, pale-white fringes are prominent against the dark-brown centers of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct horizontal transition is visible where the uniform, unpatterned crown meets the heavily scaled texture of the nape and mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The bird exhibits a highly repetitive imbricated pattern across the entire dorsal surface, created by dark feather centers and sharply defined pale crescent-shaped edges.
